screening.reason: Analyses multi-site ABIDE resting-state fMRI functional connectivity and temporal entropy in an ASD-vs-control group-difference analysis; satisfies inclusion 2-3.

evidence_spans.text: Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) and structural imaging data of 85 individuals with ASD and 163 matched controls from multiple sites of the ABIDE data set (Di Martino et al., 2014) were included in this study for a total of N = 248 individuals.
evidence_spans.claim: Final analysed cohort: 85 ASD and 163 matched controls (N=248) from multiple ABIDE sites.

evidence_spans.text: Frames with excessive motion were identiﬁed and scrubbed  (Power et al., 2012) if the framewise displacement exceeded  0.3 mm. Individuals with >10% of their frames ﬂagged for  scrubbing were excluded.
evidence_spans.claim: Motion scrubbing threshold: FD>0.3mm flagged frames; individuals with >10% flagged frames excluded.

evidence_spans.text: ROIs were deﬁned as 10 mm diameter spheres whose center coordinates are given in MNI atlas space (Power et al., 2011).
evidence_spans.claim: Used the Power et al. (2011) 264-ROI functional atlas organized into 11 resting-state networks.

evidence_spans.text:
We observed that an imbalance in intra- and inter-network FC across 11 RSNs in ASD individuals (p = 0.002) corresponds to a weakened relationship with RSN
temporal entropy (p = 0.02).
evidence_spans.claim: Main finding: FC imbalance across 11 RSNs in ASD corresponds to a weaker FC-entropy relationship than in controls.

evidence_spans.text:
Further, we observed that an estimated RSN entropy model
signiﬁcantly distinguished ASD from controls (p = 0.01) and was associated with level of
ASD symptom severity (p = 0.003).
evidence_spans.claim: The entropy-model fit (not diagnosis-trained) significantly differed between ASD and control groups and correlated with ASD symptom severity.

evidence_spans.text: Importantly, no information about group membership (i.e., ASD or control) has been explicitly passed to the model.
evidence_spans.claim: The elastic-net entropy model was fit without using diagnostic group membership, i.e. it is an associational not a diagnostic-classification model.

evidence_spans.text:
The minimum MSE computed from a 10-fold cross validation
was 11.4 ± 7.2% of c1 variance, and was observed for α = 0.15.
evidence_spans.claim: Elastic-net model of FC from RSN entropy was fit with 10-fold cross-validation.

assessments.support: Explicit inclusion criteria (structural/functional scan requirements, full-scale IQ>100, FD threshold, minimum per-site N) stated.
Multi-site ABIDE cohort with per-site minimum (>=7 ASD and 7 control), demographic Table 1 referenced.
Detailed custom FSL-based pipeline (MCFLIRT, registration, scrubbing, band-pass filter, nuisance regression) fully described.
Refers to ABIDE site-specific diagnostic criteria rather than restating the diagnostic instrument directly.
Motion (FD) explicitly compared between groups and shown not significantly different (W=7,135, p=0.74); IQ>100 required as inclusion criterion.
Nuisance regression (motion, WM, CSF, global signal), scrubbing of high-motion frames, and explicit motion-equivalence check between groups.
FC (Power 264-ROI, 11 RSN) and wavelet-based entropy are both established and previously validated measures, cited and described in detail.

Wilcoxon rank-sum and multilinear regression with cross-validated elastic net are used, but explicit multiple-comparison correction across the many statistical tests reported is not detailed in the sections read.

risk_of_bias.summary: A methodologically careful multi-site ABIDE associational study with explicit motion thresholds, motion-equivalence testing between groups, and a diagnosis-blind entropy model later compared post hoc between groups.

charting.title: Imbalance of Functional Connectivity and Temporal Entropy in Resting-State Networks in Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Machine Learning Approach
charting.dataset_openly_available: Uses public ABIDE data; no code/data repository link found in the text
charting.specific_features: 264x264 FC matrix (Power 264-ROI atlas, 11 RSNs) PCA scores; wavelet-based regularity (temporal entropy) per RSN
charting.feature_extraction_tools: Custom FSL-based pipeline (MCFLIRT, FLIRT registration, nuisance regression); Power et al. (2011) 264-ROI/11-RSN atlas; elastic net (glmnet, R)
charting.top_features_identified: DMN exhibited the strongest weighting; sensory networks (SM, SM-lat, VIS, AUD, SUB) positively weighted, higher-order cognitive networks (DMN, SAL, CO, DAN, VAN, FP) negatively weighted
charting.feature_change_direction: Weaker FC-entropy relationship in ASD vs controls; FC PCA scores (c1) significantly differed between ASD and control groups
charting.model_category: Elastic-net regularized linear regression (not a diagnostic classifier — group membership not used as a predictor)
charting.validation_methodology: 10-fold cross-validation (for the FC~entropy regression, not a diagnosis classifier)
charting.performance_metrics: Mean squared error (MSE) of cross-validated regression (11.4 +/- 7.2% of c1 variance explained)
charting.key_performance_results: Minimum MSE from 10-fold CV = 11.4 +/- 7.2% of c1 variance at alpha=0.15; entropy-model fit differed significantly between ASD and control groups (p=0.01) and correlated with ASD symptom severity (p=0.003)
charting.summary_key_findings: In 85 ASD and 163 matched controls from multiple ABIDE sites, an imbalance in intra- and inter-network functional connectivity across 11 resting-state networks in ASD (p=0.002) corresponded to a significantly weaker FC-entropy relationship (p=0.02); a diagnosis-blind entropy model of FC nonetheless differed significantly between ASD and controls (p=0.01) and was associated with ASD symptom severity (p=0.003).
charting.features_associated_disorder: Imbalanced intra-/inter-network FC and weakened FC-temporal-entropy coupling across 11 RSNs, with DMN showing the strongest model weighting
charting.reviewer_notes: Despite the 'machine learning' title, the elastic-net model is used as an associational regression tool (diagnosis-blind) rather than a diagnostic classifier.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Group-difference (associational); multi-site ABIDE; n=85 ASD / 163 matched controls (N=248).
narrative_row.methods: Custom FSL-based rs-fMRI preprocessing; Power 264-ROI/11-RSN atlas; PCA of FC matrices; wavelet-based temporal entropy; elastic-net (10-fold CV) regression of FC on RSN entropy, diagnosis-blind, compared post hoc between groups.
narrative_row.outcomes: FC imbalance across 11 RSNs in ASD corresponded to a weaker FC-entropy relationship than controls; the diagnosis-blind entropy-model fit differed significantly between ASD and controls and correlated with ASD symptom severity.
narrative_row.key_limitations: No named/versioned preprocessing pipeline; no site covariate/harmonisation; diagnostic instrument not restated; no code/participant-list release found.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: A methodologically detailed multi-site ABIDE example linking connectivity and temporal-entropy dynamics, using an elastic-net model as an associational (not diagnostic) tool.
